name: Point CounterPoint Youth Sessions
description_short: Overnight chamber music camp on Lake Dunmore in Leicester, Vermont, running since 1963. Five 2027 youth sessions, each with its own ages and music director: four two-week sessions for ages 11 to 19 and a one-week Prelude for ages 8 to 13. Days mix coachings, lessons, rehearsals and concerts with swimming, games and weekly trips.
activities: Canoeing on Lake Dunmore (Fourth of July)
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp sits on the shore of Lake Dunmore. The daily schedule includes an optional early morning swim and afternoon swimming, and on the Fourth of July campers watch fireworks from canoes on the lake. The site doesn't describe waterfront supervision.
refund_policy_summary: Once a camper is accepted, a $1,000 enrollment deposit counts toward tuition, and tuition is due in full by June 1. Withdraw by April 30 and half of what you've paid comes back; from May 1 all payments are forfeited.

warnings: The faculty lists on the page are for 2026 sessions. The 2027 faculty may be different.
The phone number depends on the time of year: June-Sept (802) 247-8467, Oct-May (267) 886-5359. The Oct-May number is recorded because today is October.
No prices are on this page. Tuition is on a separate page.
